doc: Under the Autonomous preset a Say proposal whose tasks run on an API-key profile (priced in usd, no subscription week to check) and stay within the manager's cells (2 agents of 8, the forecast's p90 under $150) starts with no job/approve: once say-proposal names the job it is no longer proposed, no proposal card was raised, and a decision records who started it (the Autonomous preset within its cells). Pattern B: a virtual clock; each check reads after the event that follows the fact it checks.

args: mkdir -p $ROOT/repo && cd $ROOT/repo && git init -q && git -c user.name=t -c user.email=t@t commit -q --allow-empty -m init

text: say ```drgnx-proposal\nsay {"title": "Two fixes", "tasks": [{"n": 1, "title": "Fix one", "role": "implement", "profile": "mock-gw", "deps": [], "body": "Fix the first."}, {"n": 2, "title": "Fix two", "role": "implement", "profile": "mock-gw", "deps": [], "body": "Fix the second."}]}\nsay ```

sql: select count(*) from job where id = '$job' and status <> 'proposed' and json_extract(data, '$.waits') is null
select count(*) from card where job = '$job' and kind = 'proposal'
select author, reason from decision where job = '$job'
rows: started by the Autonomous preset within its cells
